title: dichanthelium pantrichum
intro: Dichanthelium pantrichum, commonly known as Panicled Rosedege Grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and treating wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dichanthelium pantrichum include its ability to act as an analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in relieving pain, spasms, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
